findings.message: Decision "risk" → zeebe:calledDecision. Camunda 7 had no result variable; Camunda 8 requires one, so "decisionResult" was set.
findings.suggestion: Rename resultVariable to what downstream elements expect.

findings.message: Camunda 7 result mapper "resultList" (the default) shapes the result differently from Camunda 8, which stores the decision's own result: a value for one output, a context for several, a list for collect hit policies.
findings.suggestion: Check what downstream elements read, and add an output mapping if they expect the Camunda 7 shape.

findings.message: Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.10.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.
